metadata.title: Boliviana | A Taste of Bolivia
metadata.description: Boliviana brings together Bolivian pastries, specialty coffee, and wine in the heart of Berlin.

hero.subtitle: One bite. One sip. One story.

about.title: About Boliviana
about.intro: Die Seele Boliviens, Caraya Coffee, and Miskisimi — three Bolivian brands, one café in the heart of Berlin.
about.lead: One café, three direct-trade stories from Bolivia — told one bite, one sip, and one story at a time.

dieSeeleBoliviens.name: Die Seele Boliviens
dieSeeleBoliviens.blurb: Handmade Bolivian pastries — salteñas, cuñapés, and pucakapas made fresh by hand every day from family recipes.

carayaCoffee.name: Caraya Coffee
carayaCoffee.blurb: Bolivian specialty coffee — beans imported directly from Bolivian growers and roasted in small batches right here in Berlin.

miskisimi.name: MiskiSimi
miskisimi.blurb: Bolivian wine & Singani — high-altitude wines and Bolivia's protected national spirit, imported directly from family-run wineries.
